debts.statement: the admitted subset is the ratified construct table, not the whole of Effect Schema
a reference names its target by that target's content address, and the references table is assembled at materialization
the rev-0/rev-1 Integer disagreement is a spelling question only, the safe-integer bound being carried on both sides
nominally distinct brands collapse to one address unless brand is minted as an identity-bearing check
variance defect D1 is decided before the first libfree corpus run rather than before this lane
whether the store-reference code is sugar for declaration row zero is kept open by construction
a kind whose own code spells its tag cannot leave that tag to callers, because the tag is then part of the address
the TypeScript door does not yet admit declaration-carrying schemas, a root asymmetry rather than a defect
the declaration registry's wire-identity table lives in its own module's docstring and not in REGISTRY.md
Effect's generated text collapses an all-bare-literal union and loses its oneOf mode
the tree-sitter materializer lane stays blocked on recursion and named references, union having landed
materialized source is committed and therefore typechecked, so a stale snapshot is a red suite
the estate-native register prints each committed payload back through the ingestion door
Effect's empty struct admits excess properties where the Lean decoder refuses them
a Declaration's annotation bag is read tolerantly, with the registry's own keys consumed as required
the program emitter routes through the defunctionalized table rather than lowering trees straight to source
the surface ledger walks the backend modules as well as the library root
the dormant effect-replay vocabulary is reactivated by ruling before any utterance slice, not during one
the estate's Effect lock and the front-end lanes' pin are one decision with one owner
the put verb takes the described canonical node document, not bytes and a tag
every command-line verb carries a machine-readable second register
the architecture capability matrix carries a row for every shipped adapter
Effect's MCP pin emits an output schema only for object-typed results
every ruling has an enforcing declaration, and the index fails in both directions
a derived union orders its members by ascending tag string, so shuffling constructors does not move an address
the constructor-alternative deriving path refuses parametric and indexed types by name
the discriminant field name is reserved in every derived member and bounds the member field names below it
the hand mirror of a derived union spells the union constructor with an explicit oneOf mode
